label: daily-unwrap-validity-loki-defaults
description: Unwrap range metrics over a numeric field, a unit string, a missing label and a conversion: only the rows that make a Loki sample are read, so a missing label or a unit string answers no series and the numeric shapes keep their time. Run with the control set.

rows.shape: U1 json duration_ms sum by service
U1 json duration_ms sum by service
U2 json duration_ms max by service
U2 json duration_ms max by service
U3 json duration_ms sliding sum
U3 json duration_ms sliding sum
U4 logfmt size_bytes sum by service
U4 logfmt size_bytes sum by service
U5 logfmt ttl unit string (no sample)
U5 logfmt ttl unit string (no sample)
U6 missing label, no parser
U6 missing label, no parser
U7 missing label, ungrouped sum
U7 missing label, ungrouped sum
U8 rate of an unwrapped label
U8 rate of an unwrapped label
U9 bytes() conversion
U9 bytes() conversion
U12 json duration_ms over every service
U12 json duration_ms over every service
U13 logfmt latency_ms over every service
U13 logfmt latency_ms over every service
U14 duration() of a unit string
U14 duration() of a unit string
U10 instant sum_over_time unwrap
U11 instant max_over_time missing label
